Emily: Quick sync  I dropped a new draft of the tri-mode landing doc. Need microcopy passes for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + CTAs and a webinar signpost. https://docs.google.com/example
Jonah: Got it. Two hero angles to A/B: performance/economics vs security/trust.
Rachel: My rec: performance for Dedicated, compliance for Private, simplicity for Hosted.
Mike: SEO: include 'inference API', 'dedicated GPU', 'private deployment' in headings. Keep meta <155 chars.
Sophie: Inbound routing  map CTAs to CRM tags: hosted_trial, dedicated_request, private_demo. Make buttons explicit.
Emily: CTA labels in doc (copied here):
Emily: ```
Hosted — Start free Hosted API
Dedicated — Reserve Dedicated Capacity
Private — Request a Private Deployment Demo
```
Jonah: Suggest tweak: add short explainer under Dedicated button about SLA tiers instead of long label.
Rachel: Agree  keep button short, explainer line is better.
Mike: Meta suggestion: "Redwood Inference  predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Reduce latency and cost while keeping control."
Sophie: Webinar idea: small banner "Live webinar: Choosing the right inference deployment — watch replay" with an interest radio that tags CRM.
Emily: Need a 1-line benchmark callout for the page. Jonah can you draft?
Jonah: "Benchmarks: ~75ms token latency on typical configs  view model-by-model results."
Rachel: Layout: 3-column comparison (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with one-liners, a few key metrics, and one CTA each. Use icons.
Marvin (deploy-bot): staging deploy finished: https://staging.redwood.ai (build 2026-04-01-17:02) :white_check_mark:
Emily: Awesome. Action items: Jonah finalize benchmark blurb + pick hero variant A/B by EOD; Rachel refine microcopy for 3-col; Mike finalize SEO headings/meta; Sophie wire CTA->CRM mapping and webinar tag. Post updates here when ready. :pray:
